jump: R11.71 scaled get_RisingGravity for the whole ascent -> physics jitter above ~1.2x. R11.72 applies the multiplier only while Player.IsGrounded() is true: the launch speed is computed before the controller leaves the ground, so the impulse still scales, while the airborne integration keeps the vanilla value and stays smooth.
note: Player.set_LastStartJumpTime is fed from GameFacade.CurrentGameTimer()[0x10] (match clock), not Time.realtimeSinceStartup, so a time-window gate was not usable.
